chunks: Then We are more knowing of those who are most deserving of it in burning.
ai.seo_question: Who is most deserving of Hellfire according to Surah Maryam?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Maryam, this verse serves as a divine reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad, affirming that Allah possesses superior knowledge compared to human judgment regarding the ultimate fate of individuals. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a counter to those who claim exclusive righteousness, emphasizing that true 'closeness' (wilayah) to the Hereafter is determined by divine decree and inner reality rather than superficial piety. It underscores the precision of divine justice, where the 'most deserving' are identified by their actual spiritual standing in the sight of Allah.
